lead: Trendione (estra-4,9,11-triene-3,17-dione; code RU-2065; nicknamed 'Trenavar' or 'Trenevar') is a steroid that is a metabolite of the anabolic steroid trenbolone and has been sold online as a prohormone-type supplement. Users who take prohormones of this type aim for a leaner, more muscular physique, and one T Nation member described a 'shredded' look after using it.[1][5]

The proposed chain is that the body converts a precursor into the active steroid, in the way androstenedione relates to testosterone; Wikipedia draws this comparison.[1] In receptor assays trendione itself binds androgen and progesterone receptors more than 100-fold less strongly than trenbolone.[1][3]

Most published work on it concerns environmental fate: trenbolone acetate is used as a cattle growth implant, and trendione is excreted in manure and studied in soil and runoff.[2][4] It is listed in the US Designer Anabolic Steroid Control Act of 2014.[1] No human trials of trendione have been published.

angle.text: Supplement users take it hoping to build muscle and lose fat, as a precursor to the potent anabolic steroid trenbolone. Reports of its effects come from user anecdotes rather than studies.

infobox: Listed in the 2014 Designer Anabolic Steroid Control Act[1]

paras: Wikipedia classes trendione as an androgen, anabolic steroid and progestogen prohormone and describes it as inactive itself, with affinity for the androgen and progesterone receptors more than 100-fold lower than trenbolone.[1] A receptor study found the affinity of the major trenbolone metabolites, including trendione, was under 5 percent of that of 17beta-trenbolone.[3]

Wikipedia describes it as a designer steroid sold online as a dietary supplement.[1] On T Nation, a poster listing past anabolic use said low-dose 'trenevar' in 2015 helped them get very lean.[5] Another thread asks how long trendione and related products remain traceable in the body.[6]
The same Wikipedia article cites a 2016 Military Medicine case report of acute pancreatitis linked to a supplement containing anabolic-androgenic steroids.[1]
Trendione is named in the US Designer Anabolic Steroid Control Act of 2014.[1]

Studies of cattle implanted with trenbolone acetate identify 17alpha-trenbolone and trendione as main metabolites in manure. Research has examined how they degrade in agricultural soils, sorb to soil and break down under light.[2][4]
No studies found. Published work is limited to laboratory receptor assays and environmental studies.

lore.intro: On T Nation, trendione appears in threads on prohormones, recomposition and drug-test detection windows.[5][6]

claims.claim: Trendione ('Trenavar') produces a lean, shredded physique

name: Trendione

card.summary: A trenbolone metabolite sold as a prohormone; studied mostly in cattle-manure environmental research, not in people.
card.note: Listed in the US 2014 Designer Anabolic Steroid Control Act.

quick.overview:
Trendione is a trenbolone metabolite that has been sold online as a prohormone supplement. It is listed in the US 2014 designer steroid law.

No human studies exist.
quick.mechanism: It is inactive by itself in receptor assays; the idea is that the body converts it to trenbolone.
quick.risks: No human safety data. Legal restrictions apply in the US.
